headline: Mozambique: DP World wants to raise Maputo port traffic to 650,000 TEU by 2027
summary: DP World plans to lift cargo handled at its Maputo operations from 225,000 to about 650,000 twenty-foot equivalent units by the second half of 2027. The expansion aims to strengthen Mozambique's maritime and logistics role in southern Africa.
why: DP World is a Dubai-based port operator that runs container terminals worldwide. Volume growth at its terminals affects regional trade flows and logistics revenue.
original_headline: Mozambique : DP World veut porter le trafic du port de Maputo à 650 000 EVP d’ici 2027
